data.long_meaning: Derived from the Basque word 'ikusi', which means 'to look' or 'to see'. Iker has been used as a given name, particularly in the Basque region, meaning 'worker' or 'helper'. The name Iker carries the meaning “Worker, helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Iker usually hope their child will grow to embody worker, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
